messages.author: 15b83800b6e91096
messages.subject: grouping variable
parts:
Hi all,

Brand new to both r and lavaan (have typically done CFA in mplus). I'm struggling with discerning how to define the grouping variable for a multigroup CFA with lavaan.

I include group="intl", in my CFA command (fit <- cfa(model, data=data, group="intl", estimator="WLSMV", std.lv=TRUE)

intl is the first column of my data (1 = person from US, 2 = person not from US), but the error seems to suggest the grouping variable is not found (Error in lav_data_full(data = data, group = group, cluster = cluster,  : 
  lavaan ERROR: grouping variable ‘intl’ not found;)

I imagine this is a fairly straightforward thing to discern, but I'm having a hard time tracking down some concrete answer, especially in light of my newness to R. Any insight would be appreciated!

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: grouping variable
parts: I'm struggling with discerning how to define the grouping variable for a multigroup CFA with lavaan.
Your syntax is correct.
lavaan ERROR: grouping variable ‘intl’ not found;)

Can you verify whether 

"intl" %in% names(data)

messages.subject: Re: grouping variable
parts: I receive the statement: [1] FALSE

Then it is not a variable in the object data.  You could look at head(data) to visually verify it is not there.

FYI, data() is am R function, so it is safer to name your data set something else, like myData or dat.
